effect.name: VHS Suite
effect.desc: Five-preset analog video simulation (Glitch, Camera View, VHS Play, Ghosting TV, CRT Blur) built from three passes: chromatic aberration, sharpen/blur kernels, screen bend, YIQ tape smear, ghost frames, static bands, on-screen text/timecode rendering from a font texture, scanline/grille shading, and a VHS texture overlay with global intensity, speed, and tint.
